sn35.155:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.155:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante dhammakathiko hotīti || || 4
sn35.155:2.1: Cakkhussa ce bhikkhu nibbindāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti || Dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya || ||
sn35.155:2.2: Cakkhussa ce bhikkhu nibbindāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti || Dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya || ||
sn35.155:2.3: Cakkhussa ce bhikkhu nibbindā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti || Diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya || || 5-8
sn35.155:2.5: Manassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti || Dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya || ||
sn35.155:2.6: Manassa ce bhikkhu nibbindāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti || Dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya || ||
sn35.155:2.7: Manassa ce bhikkhu nibbindā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti || Diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāyāti || ||
